title: Record actual preparation completion
purpose: Record or correct actual completion separately from membership closure.
summary: Record or correct the actual time preparation was completed. This is separate from closing membership.

tasks.title: Record completion
steps: Enter the actual completion in laboratory local time. Record the start first.

good_to_know: Saving completion does not close membership, and closing membership does not fill in completion.
Analysis cannot be timed before the recorded completion.
Once a submitted or approved result relies on this preparation, completion cannot change.

sections.title: Context and field
paragraphs: Active internal staff with a laboratory role can read this workspace. Analysts can create and change preparation work. An admin has operational analyst access; a client account or superuser status alone does not grant it.
The Preparation panel displays Batch, Preparation method, Matrix and Actual start. Existing completion is prefilled.

items.label: Actual preparation completion
items.description: Required actual time in the laboratory time zone. Record the start first. Completion must be at or after the start, no more than two minutes ahead of the server clock, and no later than any existing linked result or preparation QC analysis.

items.label: Save preparation completion
items.description: Saves completion and an attributed before/after audit event. Any submitted or approved result revision relying on the preparation blocks the change; record new preparation instead. The current batch is checked against the form version; reload and reconcile stale evidence. Membership may be closed.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the batch without saving.

sections.title: Meaning of completion
paragraphs: Closing membership does not populate completion, and saving completion does not close membership. Result analysis must not precede completion when one is recorded, otherwise it must not precede start. No existing analytical revision is silently rewritten.
